questions.question: The force required just to move a body up an inclined plane is double the force required just to prevent the body sliding down. If the coefficient of friction is 0.25, the angle of inclination of the plane is :-
questions.explanation:
Retardation in upward motion = g(sinθ + μcosθ)
∴ Force required just to move up Fup = mg (sinθ + µcosθ) 
Similarly for down ward motion a = g(sinθ – µcosθ)
∴ Force required just to prevent the body sliding down Fdn = mg(sinθ – μcosθ)
According to problem Fup = 2Fdn
⇒ mg (sinθ + μcosθ) = 2mg (sinθ – μcosθ)
⇒ sinθ + μcosθ = 2 sinθ – 2μ cosθ
⇒ 3 μ cosθ = sinθ
⇒ tanθ = 3μ
⇒ θ = tan–1 (3μ) = tan–1(3 ×0.25) = tan–1 (0.75)
      = 37°
